description: This file defines a client-side JavaScript module that provides a service to generate family-friendly trash-talk messages for a Tic Tac Toe game by interfacing with the OpenAI API. It exports an async function to produce AI-generated comments based on the current game context.

methods.name: generateTrashTalk(context)
methods.description: Generates a playful, family-friendly trash-talking message for a Tic Tac Toe game, using the OpenAI API, based on provided game context.
